quickAdd.hint: Separate with commas or spaces. 1-22 is a range and 55x2 is two copies. R12 is card 12’s reverse holo, PB12 is card 12’s Poké Ball version and MB12 is card 12’s Master Ball version, and ranges work too (R1-R20). Special prints are marked by tapping them.
quickAdd.empty: Main set cards are 1–131 (secret rares start at 132).

help.tiers: Standard, Complete, Master or Grand Master: pick what you’re collecting above the cards. Standard is the 131 main set cards, Complete is all 180 cards, Master adds the 267 reverse holos, Poké Ball holos and Master Ball holos and Grand Master adds the 25 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards). Cards you’ve marked are kept when you switch.

reverse: Reverse holo, from Prismatic Evolutions booster packs.
pokeball: Poké Ball pattern holo, from Prismatic Evolutions booster packs.
masterball: Master Ball pattern holo, from Prismatic Evolutions booster packs. These are much rarer than the other versions of the card.

about.title: About the Prismatic Evolutions set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Prismatic Evolutions is a Scarlet & Violet expansion released on 17 January 2025. It has 180 cards: 131 in the main set and 49 secret rares. For a master set there are also 267 reverse holos, Poké Ball holos and Master Ball holos, and 25 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 131 main set cards), the Complete set (all 180 cards), the Master set (447 cards, adding every reverse holos, Poké Ball holos and Master Ball holos) or the Grand Master set (472 cards, adding the 25 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
